metadata.prompt:
Feature complete and verified working.

New CLI commands:
```
$ deciduous unlink --help
Remove an edge between two nodes

Usage: deciduous unlink <FROM> <TO>

Arguments:
  <FROM>  Source node ID
  <TO>    Target node ID

$ deciduous delete --help  
Delete a node and all its connected edges

Usage: deciduous delete [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  Node ID to delete

Options:
      --dry-run  Show what would be deleted without actually deleting
```

Files modified:
- src/main.rs: +53 lines (command definitions + handlers)
- src/db.rs: +127 lines (DeleteSummary struct + delete_edge + delete_node)
- src/lib.rs: +2 lines (export DeleteSummary)

Example usage:
```bash
# Remove edge from node 5 to node 12
$ deciduous unlink 5 12
Removed edge (5 -> 12)

# Preview what deleting node 42 would do
$ deciduous delete 42 --dry-run
Dry run: Would delete node 42 (Some goal title) with 3 edge(s)

# Actually delete the node
$ deciduous delete 42
Deleted node 42 (Some goal title) and 3 edge(s)

# Error case - edge doesn't exist
$ deciduous unlink 5 99
Error: No edge from node 5 to node 99. Node 5 has edges to: 12, 15, 18

# Error case - node doesn't exist
$ deciduous delete 9999
Error: Node 9999 does not exist. Run 'deciduous nodes' to see existing nodes.
```
